get.summary: Get a plugin's JSON Schema (alternative path)
get.description: Equivalent to `GET /apisix/admin/plugins/{plugin_name}`. Provided for symmetry with `GET /apisix/admin/schema/{resource}`.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the loaded plugin, selected by subsystem and schema_type. Plugin schemas and Lua validation depend on the installed plugin set.

keyAuthConsumer.summary: key-auth with schema_type=consumer (from release/3.18 plugin source)

parameters.name: schema_type
parameters.description: Use consumer to retrieve the consumer schema; otherwise returns the plugin schema.
